g.text: | Physics-First Rooftop Solar Screening & Grid Integration Platform
• Target Bus ID: pv_bus (71 Eligible Buses)
Verified via build_feeder.py against IEEE reference
HERO CORE INNOVATION: DUAL-LAYER AI PRE-SCREEN & PHYSICS ENGINE
• Feature Vector (18 Inputs): pv_bus, total_pv_kw, new_pv_kw, base_voltage_pu, feeder_distance_km, upstream_r_x_z, transformer_sn_kva, load_to_transformer_ratio, pv_penetration_ratio
• Outputs: Instant Risk Class (SAFE / CAUTION / CONSTRAINED) + Class Probabilities
Zero Data Leakage: ML model sees NO simulation metrics (voltage/loading)
• Methodology: BASE Case (Existing PV) vs. PV Case (Existing + New PV) Differential Power Flow
• Physical Measurements: Feeder Vmin/Vmax (pu), Target Bus Voltage Rise ΔV (pu), Line Loading (%), Transformer Loading (%)
• Reverse Flow Detection: Identifies active power reversal (P < 0) back to substation transformer
• System Loss Calculation: Computes baseline power loss vs. delta active power losses (kW)
Exact physical solver call: pp.runpp(net, algorithm='nr', max_iteration=500, tol=1e-3)
• Max V > 1.05 pu | Min V < 0.90 pu
• Binary Bisection Algorithm: Solves ~11 power flow runs per bus to find exact max allowable solar kW
• Per-Bus Capacity: Evaluates single-bus injection limits
• Feeder-Section Capacity: Evaluates simultaneous section injection (prevents 23× overestimation error)
• 2D Single Line Diagram: Exact electrical graph topology rendering via TwinDiagram.tsx (respect_switches=True)
• 3D Geospatial Twin: CesiumJS 3D viewer (GridTwin3D.tsx) with fly-to camera controls & voltage heatmaps
• 2D GIS Map: Leaflet map (GridMap.tsx) with distance-scaled bus placement
• NVIDIA NIM Integration: LLM Grid Assistant (ai_assistant.py) for citizen & DISCOM support
• Strict Tool Grounding: Answers derived exclusively from pandapower & grid database (Zero hallucination)
• Natural Language Explanation: Explains complex voltage/loading constraints
6. routes_scheme.py — PM Surya Ghar Subsidy Calculator
• Security Middleware: JWT Authentication + Per-process Rate Limiting
• Supabase Postgres Database: 13 Relational Tables + 6 DB Migrations
• Row Level Security (RLS): 29 Enforced Security Policies
• Zero Client Write Security: simulation_results & risk_assessments have NO client write policy — written ONLY via service role
• Column-Level REVOKE Protection: Prevents privilege escalation (role self-promotion) & unauthorized vendor verification
• Audit & File Storage: Secure document uploads with magic byte validation & 5-minute signed URLs
MULTI-STAKEHOLDER USER PORTALS & FINAL SYSTEM OUTPUTS
• Instant Pre-Screening: Feasibility check in milliseconds before filing
• Application Tracker: Live tracking (APPLIED → APPROVED → INSTALLED → VERIFIED)
• PM Surya Ghar Subsidy Estimator: Central Financial Assistance (CFA) calculation
• Application Queue Review: Approval, Engineering Review & Rejection Workflow
• Power Flow Inspector: Deep physical metrics (Vmin/max, ΔV rise, Line/Trafo loading)
• Interactive Tools: 2D/3D Grid Digital Twin, Hosting Capacity Heatmap & What-If Simulator
• Verified Lead Management: Citizen application matching & appointment scheduling
• Site Visit Scheduler: Inspection booking & technical feasibility recording
• Completion Filing: Installation report with 6-point checklist & photo verification
• Live SCADA / AMI Feeds: Dynamic Smart Meter Telemetry Ingestion
• Time-Series Profiles: Seasonal Load Curve Simulations
• Satellite Irradiance: Google Earth Engine / CAMS Live Feed
